fusions.name: Slipped Edge
fusions.desc: Flicks a sliver of reef that deals 4 damage to the first enemy it meets and makes it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds. 50% more critical chance until something has bled.

fusions.name: Under the Plate
fusions.desc: Throws a thin blade at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 28 damage, rising to twice that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds. Against a boss or an elite it also deals 5% of their maximum health.

fusions.name: Hidden Stingers
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds. A line of stingers fights beside you for 8 seconds, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Second Look
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands. Your armour rises by 5%.
